title: Use keyframes in Magnific to define the action beats (Trip → Popcorn → Drink →…
content:
Use keyframes in Magnific to define the action beats (Trip → Popcorn → Drink → Hat → Watch → Freeze) before generating motion in Seedance 2.5  
In Seedance 2.5, animate the camera moving through the frozen moment, then reverse/rewind the motion to “rewind reality” for a payoff shot
